description: This file defines an abstract class AbstractUnary for unary expression nodes within the Twig templating engine. It provides constructor validation, a compile method to handle code generation with optional parentheses, and an abstract method operator that subclasses must implement.

classes.name: AbstractUnary
classes.description: An abstract class representing unary expression nodes in Twig, providing common functionality and requiring subclasses to implement the specific operator method.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the unary node with a node and line number, issuing a deprecation warning if the node is not an instance of AbstractExpression.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code for the unary expression, wrapping the operator and node with parentheses if explicitly specified.

methods.name: operator
methods.description: Abstract method that subclasses must implement to output the specific operator during compilation.
